title: AI Settings
subtitle: Configure the engine powering each AI function
personaHint: Describe how the assistant should speak and behave. This guides every AI response.
rulePlaceholder: e.g. Always confirm the order number before refunding
scenarioHint: These buttons appear in the customer chat widget menu, in this order.
label: Label
contextPromptPlaceholder: Describe what should be flagged; an LLM will judge each message

preview.title: Chat preview
preview.hint: Runs the real pipeline (persona, rules, knowledge, moderation) on an isolated session — agents are never alerted.
preview.empty: Ask a question as a customer, or press a scenario button.
preview.agentMode: (bot silent — thread is with an agent)

editor.replyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the built-in reply
editor.blankHint: Blank fields fall back to the built-in script (per language).
editor.noScriptHint: This action has no scripted reply — set where the shopper goes after it below.
editor.utteranceHint: Shown in the thread as if the customer had typed it when they press the button.
editor.defaultShownHint: The shipped text is filled in. Edit it to override; leave it as is and nothing is saved.

handoff.title: Agent handoff
handoff.assigneesHint: Leave empty to alert every agent — the first to accept takes the conversation.
handoff.noAgents: No agents with the consult label yet.
handoff.useBusinessHours: Route to agents only during business hours
handoff.noticePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default wording
handoff.emailWarning: Without an email, off-hours escalations still page agents.
handoff.breakHint: Questions during the break are routed like off hours.
handoff.movedToSettings: Business hours and off-hours routing now live in tenant Settings.
handoff.denyHint: Messages matching any keyword are sent straight to an agent — the AI is not asked. Type/label stamp the created issue.
handoff.slaHint: Drives the board's warning/overdue badges. 1-168h; defaults 24h / 4h.
handoff.denyModeHint: "No answer" hands the thread to a person without replying. "Answer, then hand off" replies from the knowledge base first and still hands it over — the agent is paged either way.

coach.title: Agent coaching
coach.approvalNotice: Coaching proposes changes — nothing is applied until you approve it.
coach.empty: Tell the agent how it should behave, or ask why it answered something.
coach.emptyExample: e.g. "Refund replies sound too cold — open with a line of empathy."
coach.moderationBlocked: This reply was blocked by your moderation rules. That block is itself the finding — check the rule that matched.
coach.editHint: The agent drafted this. What you save here is what takes effect.
coach.toastApplied: Proposal applied to your AI configuration.
coach.stubWarningBody: Replies are canned text and no change proposals will be produced. Assign a real engine to Coaching under AI functions.
coach.kbRevertHint: Undo from the document's revision history.

answerReuse.title: Answer reuse
answerReuse.desc: Verified past answers (agent replies, high-confidence cited AI answers) are replayed for near-duplicate questions before calling the AI engine. Edit or disable entries here; disable all after a large knowledge update.
answerReuse.saveError: Failed to update the answer-reuse entry.
answerReuse.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? It will no longer be replayed.
answerReuse.deactivateAllConfirm: Deactivate every stored answer? New questions will always go to the AI engine until entries are re-enabled or re-learned.

regression.title: Regression check
regression.hint: Re-asks the same questions so a config change can be judged on more than one reply. Wording shifts on every call — this shows what moved, it does not pass judgement.
regression.empty: No questions yet. Add one you care about getting right.
regression.addPlaceholder: e.g. How long does delivery take?
regression.sameConfigNotice: Both runs used the same configuration, so every difference below is the model's own variance — not the effect of a change.

history.title: Change history
history.hint: Every version the persona and response rules have had, and why. Restoring loads a version into the editors above — it goes live only when you save.
history.restoreNotice: Loads into the editors above. Nothing changes until you save.
history.toastLoaded: Loaded into the editors. Review it, then save.
history.notePlaceholder: Why this change? (optional, saved to the history)

agents.title: AI agents
agents.hint: Each agent is one counter with its own persona — landing visitors, internal staff, hotel partners… Select one to edit its persona below. Pages pin an agent via the install snippet; everything else answers as the default.
agents.deleteConfirm: Delete agent "{{name}}"? Pages using its code will fall back to the default agent.
agents.name: Name
agents.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used in the install snippet and locked after creation.
agents.snippetCopyFailed: Could not copy — select and copy manually.
agents.snippetHint: Paste on the page that should talk as this agent. Already installed? Just add the agent line to SHARPTALK_WIDGET_CONFIG.
agents.displayNameHint: Shown to shoppers in the widget header. Blank = store display name.
agents.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! I'm Livy — how can I help?
agents.greetingHint: First bubble for sessions on this agent. Blank language = store-wide first message.

agentScope.title: Agents for this button
agentScope.subtitle: per-button agent scope
agentScope.saveHint: Takes effect when you save the scenario buttons.

scriptNone: No built-in script — the label is sent as a chat message (AI answers it)

scripts.title: Built-in conversations
scripts.hint: Every script SharpTalk ships with, including the ones a customer only reaches through a follow-up chip.

effective.title: What {{agent}} says
effective.hint: The values in effect for this agent. Each one is edited in the section it belongs to, below.

labelLanguageHint: A label typed here applies to that language only; the rest keep theirs.
buttonMessageHint: Leave empty to send the label as the question.

answerFooter.title: Answer contact footer
answerFooter.hint: Appends the same contact block to every AI knowledge answer. The AI no longer writes contacts itself, so numbers are never altered or masked.
answerFooter.fallback: If the customer language is empty: EN, then the first language written
answerFooter.protectedHint: One per line. E-mails and phone numbers in the footer are included automatically. PII masking rules never hide these values.
answerFooter.saveError: Could not save the answer footer
